scene_sentence_zh: 荒草叢生的鄉間小徑通往遠方的地平線，曠野的風掠過乾燥的土壤。

license.terms: Original artwork generated for this repository by its maintainers and committed with the project; it may be redistributed under the project's own repository terms. No third-party stock imagery, scraped artwork, or externally licensed asset is included.

production.method: sd-webui txt2img through the repository's internal client (world.art.sd_worker.SDWebUIClient.generate) using the shipped prompt library, then local WebP encoding through world.art.formats.encode
production.description: an open country path of hard-packed pale earth winding away toward a distant flat horizon across rolling grassland, dry rust-gold grass and scattered wildflowers crowding the trail, a lone leaning waymarker post and a few wind-bent shrubs in the middle distance, low hills dissolving into pale atmospheric blue haze under a vast open sky, warm late afternoon light with long soft shadows, an unobstructed open grassy foreground

visual_review.native_scale: Reviewed at native 1536x864: a painterly JRPG open-country landscape with an unobstructed lower foreground for stage figures, no interface, watermark or readable lettering, and no town/forest reuse.
visual_review.desktop_cover_crop: Reviewed under the desktop 1451x790 cover crop (browser method web.tests.browser.test_browser_bundled_scene_assets.BundledSceneAssetsBrowserTest.test_outdoor_pack_static_decode): the full-bleed composition holds and the illustration stays distinguishable from its siblings at that viewport.
visual_review.contact_sheet: Reviewed as a three-up contact sheet beside mountain_path and coastal_path: scene identity, palette and composition are distinct for every sibling.
